_comment: 配置基线默认值。数值与 operator / risk_level 为内置默认阈值。operator 取值：= > < >= <= != BETWEEN LIKE。BETWEEN 时用 expected_value_min / expected_value_max。h2 一组是平台自检基线（校验的是内置 H2 自检库自身，而非生产库），刻意包含会「不合规」与「未采集」的条目，用来覆盖三种判定结果。

oracle.query_sql: SELECT NAME, VALUE FROM V$PARAMETER WHERE NAME='failed_login_attempts'
oracle.description_zh: 登录失败尝试次数应 <= 5，防止暴力破解
oracle.description_en: Failed login attempts should be <= 5 to prevent brute force

oracle.query_sql: SELECT NAME, VALUE FROM V$PARAMETER WHERE NAME='password_life_time'
SELECT NAME, VALUE FROM V$PARAMETER WHERE NAME='audit_trail'
SELECT NAME, VALUE FROM V$PARAMETER WHERE NAME='remote_login_passwordfile'
SELECT NAME, VALUE FROM V$PARAMETER WHERE NAME='processes'
SELECT NAME, VALUE FROM V$PARAMETER WHERE NAME='sessions'
SELECT NAME, VALUE FROM V$PARAMETER WHERE NAME='sga_target'
SELECT NAME, VALUE FROM V$PARAMETER WHERE NAME='pga_aggregate_target'

oracle.description_zh: 必须开启归档模式，否则无法做时间点恢复
oracle.description_en: Archive log mode must be enabled for point-in-time recovery

oracle.description_zh: 建议开启强制日志，保障 Data Guard 与恢复
oracle.description_en: Force logging should be enabled for Data Guard and recovery

oracle.query_sql: SELECT VALUE FROM V$PARAMETER WHERE NAME='open_cursors'
oracle.description_zh: 单会话打开游标数建议 >= 300
oracle.description_en: Open cursors per session should be >= 300

oracle.query_sql: SELECT VALUE FROM V$PARAMETER WHERE NAME='undo_retention'
oracle.description_zh: UNDO 保留时间建议 >= 900 秒

mysql.description_zh: 最大连接错误次数建议 >= 100
应关闭 local_infile，防止任意文件读取
mysql.description_en: local_infile should be OFF to prevent arbitrary file read
Error log path should be configured
InnoDB log file size should be >= 256MB

mysql.description_zh: 查询缓存应关闭（8.0 已移除，5.7 建议置 0）
sync_binlog=1 保证崩溃不丢事务
mysql.description_en: sync_binlog should be 1 for crash safety
Should be 1 to guarantee transaction durability
Binary log retention should be >= 7 days

postgresql.description_zh: 应开启 SSL 传输加密
WAL 级别应 >= replica，否则无法做复制/PITR
postgresql.description_en: WAL level should be >= replica for replication/PITR

postgresql.description_zh: 自动清理必须开启，防止事务 ID 回卷
postgresql.description_en: Autovacuum must be on to prevent transaction ID wraparound

sqlserver.description_zh: 应关闭 AUTO_CLOSE，避免频繁开关库
TRUSTWORTHY 应为 OFF，否则存在提权风险
sqlserver.description_en: TRUSTWORTHY should be off to avoid privilege escalation

sqlserver.description_zh: 未使用 Service Broker 时建议关闭
sqlserver.description_en: Service Broker should be disabled when unused

sqlserver.description_zh: 当前登录不应是 sysadmin（最小权限原则）
sqlserver.description_en: Current login should not be sysadmin (principle of least privilege)

sqlserver.query_sql: SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name='max server memory (MB)'
SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name='min server memory (MB)'
SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name='max degree of parallelism'
sqlserver.description_en: Max degree of parallelism should be >= 1

sqlserver.query_sql: SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name='cost threshold for parallelism'
sqlserver.description_zh: 并行阈值建议 >= 50（默认 5 偏低）
sqlserver.description_en: Cost threshold for parallelism should be >= 50

sqlserver.description_zh: 生产库应为 FULL 恢复模式，否则无法做日志备份
sqlserver.description_en: Production databases should use FULL recovery model

sqlserver.description_zh: 未使用全文索引时建议关闭
sqlserver.description_en: Full-text should be disabled when unused

sqlserver.query_sql: SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name='automatic database backup'

kingbase.description_zh: 应开启 SSL 传输加密

h2.query_sql: SELECT H2VERSION()
h2.description_zh: 自检库应为 H2 2.x 引擎，与平台编译期依赖一致
h2.description_en: Self-check DB should be H2 2.x, matching the platform's compile-time dependency

h2.query_sql: SELECT SETTING_VALUE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SETTINGS WHERE SETTING_NAME='MODE'
h2.description_zh: 自检库应运行在 REGULAR 模式（非 MySQL/PG 兼容模式）
h2.description_en: Self-check DB should run in REGULAR mode

h2.query_sql: SELECT SETTING_VALUE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SETTINGS WHERE SETTING_NAME='OLD_INFORMATION_SCHEMA'
h2.description_zh: 不应启用旧版 INFORMATION_SCHEMA（列名与语义有差异）
h2.description_en: Legacy INFORMATION_SCHEMA should be disabled

h2.query_sql: SELECT SETTING_VALUE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SETTINGS WHERE SETTING_NAME='CASE_INSENSITIVE_IDENTIFIERS'
h2.description_zh: 标识符大小写应保持敏感，避免与生产库行为不一致
h2.description_en: Identifiers should stay case-sensitive

h2.query_sql: SELECT SETTING_VALUE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SETTINGS WHERE SETTING_NAME='MAX_QUERY_TIMEOUT'
h2.description_zh: 不应设置全局查询超时上限，否则长巡检会被引擎强制中断
h2.description_en: Global max query timeout should not be set

h2.query_sql: SELECT SETTING_VALUE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SETTINGS WHERE SETTING_NAME='QUERY_TIMEOUT'
h2.description_zh: 不应设置默认查询超时
h2.description_en: Default query timeout should not be set

h2.query_sql: SELECT SETTING_VALUE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SETTINGS WHERE SETTING_NAME='LOB_TIMEOUT'
h2.description_zh: LOB 句柄超时应 >= 60 秒，避免大批量元数据读取时句柄失效
h2.description_en: LOB timeout should be >= 60s

h2.query_sql: SELECT SETTING_VALUE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SETTINGS WHERE SETTING_NAME='WRITE_DELAY'
h2.description_zh: 写延迟应为 0，保证提交即持久化
h2.description_en: Write delay should be 0 for immediate durability

h2.query_sql: SELECT SETTING_VALUE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SETTINGS WHERE SETTING_NAME='RETENTION_TIME'
h2.description_zh: 不应保留已删除的旧数据页
h2.description_en: Deleted pages should not be retained

h2.query_sql: SELECT SETTING_VALUE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SETTINGS WHERE SETTING_NAME='QUERY_CACHE_SIZE'
h2.description_zh: 查询缓存条目数应在 0~64 之间
h2.description_en: Query cache size should be between 0 and 64

h2.query_sql: SELECT SETTING_VALUE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SETTINGS WHERE SETTING_NAME='AUTO_COMPACT_FILL_RATE'
h2.description_zh: 自动整理填充率应在 50~100 之间
h2.description_en: Auto-compact fill rate should be between 50 and 100

h2.query_sql: SELECT SETTING_VALUE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SETTINGS WHERE SETTING_NAME='ANALYZE_AUTO'
h2.description_zh: 自动统计信息采样行数应 >= 1000，避免计划退化
h2.description_en: Auto-analyze threshold should be >= 1000

h2.query_sql: SELECT SETTING_VALUE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SETTINGS WHERE SETTING_NAME='ANALYZE_SAMPLE'
h2.description_zh: 统计信息采样行数应 >= 1000
h2.description_en: Analyze sample size should be >= 1000

h2.query_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.LOCKS
h2.description_zh: 空闲自检库不应持有任何表锁
h2.description_en: An idle self-check DB should hold no table locks

h2.query_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SESSIONS
h2.description_zh: 会话数应在 1~50 之间，超出说明连接未正常归还
h2.description_en: Session count should be between 1 and 50

h2.query_sql: SELECT USER_NAME, IS_ADMIN FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.USERS
h2.description_zh: 自检库应只保留 SA 管理员账户（逐行判定，出现非管理员账户即不合规）
h2.description_en: Only the SA admin account should exist (evaluated per row)

h2.query_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.USERS WHERE IS_ADMIN=TRUE
h2.description_zh: 至少应存在一个管理员账户，否则平台无法自检
h2.description_en: At least one admin account must exist

h2.query_sql: SELECT SETTING_VALUE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SETTINGS WHERE SETTING_NAME='RECOMPILE_ALWAYS'
h2.description_zh: 建议开启强制重编译：H2 默认关闭，DDL 变更后可能沿用旧执行计划
h2.description_en: Always-recompile is recommended; H2 defaults to off

h2.query_sql: SELECT SETTING_VALUE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SETTINGS WHERE SETTING_NAME='COMPRESS'
h2.description_zh: 建议开启数据压缩以降低存储占用
h2.description_en: Data compression is recommended

h2.query_sql: SELECT SETTING_VALUE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SETTINGS WHERE SETTING_NAME='DEFRAG_ALWAYS'
h2.description_zh: 不建议每次写入后整理碎片，性能代价过高
h2.description_en: Always-defrag should stay off

h2.query_sql: SELECT SETTING_VALUE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SETTINGS WHERE SETTING_NAME='EXCLUSIVE'
h2.description_zh: 不应以独占模式启动，否则其他连接无法接入
h2.description_en: Exclusive mode should be off

h2.query_sql: SELECT SETTING_VALUE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SETTINGS WHERE SETTING_NAME='ZERO_BASED_ENUMS'
h2.description_zh: 枚举值应沿用 1 起始语义，与平台驱动行为一致
h2.description_en: Enums should stay 1-based

h2.query_sql: SELECT SETTING_VALUE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SETTINGS WHERE SETTING_NAME='property.java.runtime.version'
h2.description_zh: 平台以 JDK 17 构建与验证，自检库应运行在同一 JVM 上
h2.description_en: Self-check DB should run on the same JDK 17 JVM as the platform

h2.query_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='INFORMATION_SCHEMA'
h2.description_zh: 元数据视图应完整可读（H2 2.x 提供 30 个以上）
h2.description_en: Metadata views should be fully readable

h2.query_sql: SELECT SETTING_VALUE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SETTINGS WHERE SETTING_NAME='DEFAULT_LOCK_TIMEOUT'
h2.description_zh: 默认锁等待应 >= 5 秒；注意默认实例不暴露该设置项，采不到值时判为「未采集」而非不合规
h2.description_en: Default lock timeout should be >= 5s; absent on a default instance, so it is reported as unchecked
